optionsIntro.message: Move and Jump lets you move the selected email to a folder, or jump to a folder, using type-ahead search. Click the toolbar button, or use one of the shortcuts below — rebind them any time from Add-ons Manager → gear icon → Manage Extension Shortcuts.

optionsRankingInfo.message: Results are ranked using your past choices: folders you've picked after typing similar text come first, then your most-used folders overall (recent use counts more than older use), then alphabetically. You can type several words, in any order, to narrow the list; folders whose own name contains all of them come first. To reset a folder's ranking, highlight it in the results and click the ⤓ icon or press Shift+Delete.
optionsRankingInfo.description: Options page paragraph explaining search-result ranking

buttonJump.description: Search window button: jump to the highlighted folder

buttonCancel.description: Search window button: close without doing anything

buttonDemote.message: Reset ranking: forget how often this folder was used (Shift+Delete)
